result.title: CrossPair: Unlocking Generalist Visual Transformation Learning in Image Editors
result.summary: Language models switch tasks from demonstrations, but vision still often relies on separate systems for restoration, editing, and stylization. A before--after example offers a shared instruction only if the transferable change can be separated from the scene that demonstrates it. We introduce CrossPair, which adapts a pretrained multimodal image editor to transfer diverse transformations from one exemplar pair. Exemplar-before, exemplar-after, and query images take fixed roles in its native VLM and VAE pathways: the VLM extracts operation semantics, while the VAE retains fine appearance and structure. A training-only, change-aware DINOv3 objective aligns feature-change directions across content-distinct scenes, guiding the output to follow the demonstrated relation without an inference-time encoder. We construct Transform-360K by grouping filtered pairs from conditional representations, restoration, editing, virtual try-on, and stylization under shared transformations. On Relation252K-derived seen and held-out transformations, \method improves target agreement and edit-direction similarity over released systems. Ablations show that the semantic and visual exemplar routes are complementary and that DINO relation alignment further strengthens transfer; Transform-360K training also improves aggregate held-out-operation scores.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CrossPair，把预训练多模态图像编辑器用于从单个前后示例对迁移多种视觉变换：由 VLM 抽取操作语义、VAE 保留外观与结构，并加入仅在训练期生效的 DINOv3 变化感知目标，对齐内容不同场景间的特征变化方向。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将「可迁移变换」与「演示场景」分离、并以训练期特征变化方向做跨内容对齐的思路，可能为 LVR 中区分任务必要信息与视觉旁路、以及 latent 状态的监督与贡献分配提供可核查线索。
